February 26, 2024 Dear Institute Proposal Evaluators, I have seen the proposal for a URI Honors Institute titled “Application: URI Honors Institute” and, on behalf of the College of Arts and Sciences, I am pleased to endorse the initiative.
The College of Arts and Sciences has been a long time support of the Honors program, and I recognize the value of such a program to not just A&S students, but to the University at large.
The College of Arts and Sciences will continue to collaborate as needed, regarding the efforts of the Honors Institute, and all of its constituent units: the Honors Program, the Honors Colloquium, the Office of National Fellowships and Academic Opportunities, and the Pre-health Professions Advising Program.
I appreciate that the new budget model for the Honors Institute will allow it to function as a central service in the university.
